mode.$comment: Spec §2: chat | app | gnimsys. Only the implemented modes are accepted: app and gnimsys are refused until they are built.

agent.$comment: What the page binds: possibly nothing ({}). Unbound parts are chosen by the user as ui.runSettings allows; the run table is design §5.1 (agent only + no draft role runs PUBLISHED; nothing bound + no all-agents role shows the panel 'No agent in this link'). An empty string counts as not bound (a VB page parameter missing from the URL).

version.$comment: PUBLISHED runs the published workflow (/chat); DRAFT runs the draft through Studio's test path (/debug, invocationMode ADMIN). Absent or empty = not bound (no default: see agent).

publishedVia.$comment: Which endpoint a PUBLISHED run uses. chat = /agent/v2/<wf>/chat (the Studio chat client). debug = /agent/v2/<wf>/debug with invocationMode ADMIN, status PUBLISHED and debugParams (the vendored aistudio CLI's shape for a published run; resume = the same base + jobId + resumeInput), so the stream carries node data — for debug hosts (agent builders); VB end-user pages keep /chat (an ADMIN invocation is not for end users). Absent = chat: the documented behaviour of a PUBLISHED run before this key existed, not a data default. Only for a run that can be PUBLISHED: refused when version is DRAFT; a DRAFT run (bound or chosen) always uses /debug without status.

app.$comment: The Agentic App of mode app (spec §8, not built yet): carried so a mode switch can offer it once it is built.

modeSwitch.$comment: Debug hosts: the header's mode switch, listing the modes that are implemented and configured; a switch is a full reset.

runSettings.$comment: Who may choose what agent does not bind, matched against user.roles: allAgentsRoles = pick any agent the user can read (BOSS workflows), draftRoles = run drafts (/debug). Roles gate choosing only, never a bound run. Absent = nobody chooses; an empty list = nobody.

pageSize.$comment: Rows per server page of a datasource-backed select (the endpoint data provider's limit).

widgets.$comment: The gnimsys-ui overlay (D7): widgets[widgetId].fields[fieldId] gives a select field of that block a datasource (the dashboard REST shape or a BIPReport report, see gnimsys-ui-v1.schema.json #/$defs/dataSource; a report's valueField / labelField / searchField are its columns, searchField does not apply with searchParam, searchTemplate needs searchParam) that wins over the block's own options or datasource. A config datasource is the customer's own: datasources.allowInline / allowPrefixes gate only the datasources an agent carries inline.
